items.text: Schwab's 10-K states that in the Advisor Services arena it competes with institutional custodians, wirehouses, regional and independent broker-dealers, fintech custodians, banks, and trust companies.
items.quote: In the Advisor Services arena, we compete with institutional custodians, wirehouses, regional and independent broker-dealers, fintech custodians, banks, and trust companies.

items.text: Fidelity Investments is named as the second-largest custodian after Schwab in the RIA custody business.
items.quote: Wurster's comments come after Fidelity Investments, the second-largest custodian after Schwab, told RIAs in early October that firms with under $100 million in client assets will have to leave the platform by June 30, 2027.

items.text: Fidelity is named as Schwab's close rival in cash/custody services.
items.quote: Schwab's close rival, Fidelity , offers up to 1.94% on sweep cash, and 3.49% through its money market funds.

items.text: Altruist is named as a Vanguard-owned custodian competing in the RIA custody space.
items.quote: The now Vanguard-owned custodian, Altruist, offers 0.05% in sweep accounts, and a maximum 3.75% through a high-yield cash account.

items.text: SEI, Goldman, and Robinhood are named as custodial alternatives that RIAs might consider as competitors to Schwab.
items.quote: Do they start looking at SEI ? Do they start looking at Goldman? Do they start looking at the lead flow through Robinhood ?

items.text: BNY Pershing is named as a custodian used alongside Schwab by breakaway RIA teams.
items.quote: an advisory duo who managed about $18.6 billion in client assets at J.P. Morgan Advisors launched Latigo Peak Partners with custodians Schwab and BNY Pershing

items.text: LPL is named as an independent broker/dealer and RIA custodian.
items.quote: joining Jump as an approved agentic AI platform available to LPL's 32,000 affiliated advisors.

items.text: Vanguard, through its acquisition of Altruist, is named as a competitor that sets up to compete with Schwab in RIA custody.
